newsitem.title: USA: SITEL secures 5-year, $150 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: SITEL secures 5-year, $150 mln credit pact.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Thursday it it has completed arrangements for a five-year, $150 million revolving credit facility with a syndicate of 12 banks.

"This new credit facility provides SITEL with additional financial flexibility and resources to support the achievement of our business strategy and the continued global growth of our business," said Barry Major, chief financial officer, in a news release.
The bank group includes Bankers Trust Company, First Bank, N.A. (Minneapolis), and First Union National Bank (Charlotte, N.C.).

SITEL provides outsourced telephone-based customer service and sales programs on behalf of corporations worldwide. The company operates more than 9,000 workstations in 63 call centers in 13 countries throughout North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.
